item.title: Iowa company sent over $800,000 to scammer in 2022; US recovers about $375,000 four years later
item.description: In 2022, an Iowa company transferred over $800,000 to a scammer through a business email compromise scheme. The scam involved fraudulent vendor invoices, which led employees to believe the payments were legitimate. Although the government recovered roughly $375,000, the bulk of the funds remains unrecovered. Investigators traced part of the fraud proceeds to a Wells Fargo account before resorting to legal action. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Crop protection: A new method for understanding insect sexual communication
item.description: A team of INRAE scientists, in collaboration with Université Côte d'Azur and Nanjing Agricultural University in China, has used an innovative AI-based method to identify the sex pheromone of the lily moth1 and the olfactory receptors associated with it. The insect pest, whose caterpillars feed on these plants, is found in Asia and Oceania. This approach to identifying previously unknown molecules opens up new possibilities for identifying pheromones in other species. These molecules play a key role in certain biocontrol strategies currently used to protect crops, particularly in France. The… Fuente: Phys.org.
